0022600041.text: The Kings (1-10, 14th in the West) host the Trail Blazers (7-3, 7th in the West) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with Sacramento on a four-game losing streak and 0-6 at home, while Portland has won its last game and is 5-1 on the road. Portland won the last meeting 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, leaving the Kings trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing all four meetings to the Trail Blazers in 2025-26. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out after Achilles surgery), Maxime Raynaud (out with a dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa (day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and a game-time decision), while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle).
